_description: Office economy content (#791, #811 item 1; OFFICE_ECONOMY_PROPOSAL.md sec 2a). 'start' is the tier-0 bedroom/basement state every run begins in, hard-capped at start.hire_cap hires. 'lease_options' are the THREE offers the first-lease decision presents (Pip's 2026-07-27 ruling: 'I want 3 offices to choose from and different size floorplans to go with that'). All three are tier 1 -- 3 OPTIONS at the tier-1 decision, NOT 3 tiers total.
_sim_vs_render: hire_cap / rent_per_month / deposit / fitout / break_fee / min_term_months are SIM fields. The floorplan block is RENDER-ONLY (ADR-0018: the render layer reads sim counts; the sim never reads cells). floorplan.desk_slots is authored to equal hire_cap as a courtesy to the render layer -- the sim reads hire_cap and must never read desk_slots.
_locked_in: v1 has NO moving mechanic: once a lease is signed the office is LOCKED (Pip: 'for now lets leave players locked in with their choices, mechanically, just architect extensibility'). break_fee / min_term_months are authored NOW so the future move/downsize instrument has honest terms to bill; nothing reads them yet.

start.name: Bedroom / basement
start.flavor: A desk, a spare chair, and a router that needs a specific kick.

lease_options.name: Co-working corner
lease_options.flavor: Four hot desks behind a plant wall. Cheap in, cheap out, low ceiling.

lease_options.name: Second-floor walk-up
lease_options.flavor: Above a bakery. Warm, loud at 5am, and it has a door you can close.

lease_options.name: University annex sublet
lease_options.flavor: Shabby, enormous, and the lease runs two years. The cheapest desk in town if you last.
